properties.note: FIXED and merged in #426: cap:a-status-advance-says-whether-its-prose-predates-it. When set_capability_status / set_verification_status / set_epoch_status moves a status and the node carries prose, the reply now carries a prose_currency block naming both statuses and quoting the prose. It is option A of dec:idea-a-status-that-advances-past-its-own-prose, which was the design question this defect raised. Pinned by ver:a-status-advance-says-whether-its-prose-predates-it (observed failing first) and it fired on its own verification's planned->passing during this work. Drawn by hand because the defect fact's subject_id is the feedback artifact, not this ChangeEvent's affected nodes, so unclaimed_findings could not surface it — the documented 'change and finding hang off different nodes' limit, and the reason the fix read as open for a day after it shipped.
